The '''Nalroni''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Dog/Legends|canines]] [[Homeworld/Legends|indigenous]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]]. While most of their [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was taken up by farms and plantations, their planet's central city, [[Celanon City]], was one of the main trading cities and spaceports on the [[Celanon Spur/Legends|Celanon Spur]]. Their society was divided into the rural Nalroni and the [[City/Legends|urban]] [[Celanite]]s.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Sprax.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Sprax]]
The Nalroni were a race of [[Hair/Legends|furred]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] with [[Dog/Legends|canine]] features including pointed [[Nose/Legends|snouts]] and sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. Originally a predatory species, the Celanite Nalroni used their hunting instincts to become skilled traders and negotiators.<ref name="AE" /> Nalroni could contract diseases to which [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] were immune.<ref name="POT" />

==Society and culture==
Nearly all [[Celanite]]s were [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] who lived in the sprawling walled [[City/Legends|metropolis]] of [[Celanon City]]. In addition to commercial profits, tariffs and bribes from all offworld trade going through Celanon City made the Celanites quite wealthy. Their [[Nalroni Merchant Council|merchant guilds]] and trading companies were among the wealthiest and most influential in [[D'Astan sector/Legends|their sector]]. Celanites wore the most ornate and expensive [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] they could afford, as a mark of their status. Celanites considered their trading guilds to be more important than family or tribe.

The vast majority of Nalroni lived rural lifestyles, organized in clans and tribes. Though they modified their traditional lifestyles to use [[Droid/Legends|droid]] labor and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-supplied prefabricated housing, they were suspicious of offworld influence. The merchant guilds who ruled Celanon were sensitive to these concerns, and allowed few offworlders outside Celanon City's walls. They also made sure to distribute the wealth of Celanon City to the tribes, and limited the number of young rural Nalroni who were allowed to leave their tribe to become merchants. While the rural tribes were sometimes suspicious of the Celanites' excesses and offworld influence, they appreciated the conveniences Celanon City's prosperity gave them.

Nalroni architecture consisted of [[Wood/Legends|wood]], [[Clay/Legends|clay]] and [[Grass/Legends|grass]], with natural clay pottery and earthenware for dining.<ref name="AE" />

==Nalroni in the galaxy==
[[File:Fquallix-GG11.jpg|thumb|right|150px|F'quallix and his cronies]]
One Nalroni of note was the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Sprax]]. Others included the criminals [[Drolen Antig]]<ref name="AJ10">{{JournalCite|10|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref> and [[F'quallix]].
